attributes.cardDescription: One prior job (company, title, dates, description) from a resume, meant to be repeated with containsMany
attributes.readMe:
# Work History Entry Field ## Summary A compound FieldDef holding one prior job as reported on a resume: `company`, `title`, `startDate`/`endDate` (`DateField`), and a free-text `description`. Meant to be repeated via `containsMany` on a host card so a whole employment history round-trips without a linked card per job. ## Import ```ts import { WorkHistoryEntryField } from './work-history-entry-field'; ``` ## Usage — three or more ways this is used **1. `Candidate.workHistory`** (built, this PR) — a `containsMany` list rendered as the isolated view's "Work history" panel, and populated by the Extract Resume command's field-population step when the candidate has none yet. **2. An Employee's resume-on-file record** (future) — once hired, the same prior-employment shape is useful on the Employee card for HR reference, without re-deriving a separate "job history" structure. **3. An Alumni/Contact card tracking career history** (future) — any card that keeps a person's career trajectory (a CRM contact, an alumni directory entry) can reuse this field instead of inventing its own company/title/date-range shape. Only usage 1 is currently wired into a card; 2 and 3 are named as the second and third consumers this field is designed for, not yet built. ## Template Usage ```hbs
    <@fields.workHistory />
``` **Non-goals:** structured resume storage beyond what a human or an AI transcribes from resume text — there is no verification, background-check, or reference-check semantics here, and no attempt to normalize company names against a canonical registry. Salary/compensation history does not belong on this field (see `Offer.salary` for that). **Example in use:** `Candidate/applied-jordan` carries two work-history entries (Nimbus Analytics, Senior Frontend Engineer, 2022–present; Brightline Health, Frontend Engineer, 2019–2022), matching the career narrative already present in that candidate's AI-generated interview questions.
